summary: Round-4 bug-fix testing for TeachHub. Ran 49 backend pytest tests (all existing 43 + 6 new for drafts/hide_follows) — 100% pass. Verified all 9 requested UI fixes on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + core regressions (login, feed pagination, like/favorite, follow, language toggle, dark mode persistence).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 801 lines with models, routes, storage & auth all in one module. Same recommendation as iteration 3: split into routers/services.

Dev-only React hydration warning '<span> in <option>' still logged from Feed.jsx select options. Tooling noise (visual editor injecting span into <option>), not a functional bug — safe to ignore per main agent's note.

Workspace.jsx: draft filter logic filters by folder only; drafts still appear under 'All'/type/subject folders which is correct, but there is no explicit 'Drafts' folder for quick access — nice-to-have.

Backend build_profile returns hide_follows=True with followers_count/following_count=null when hidden; frontend PublicProfile correctly hides those stats. Consider also omitting the followers/following arrays entirely from response for stronger privacy (currently returns [] which is fine).

Header.jsx renders theme-toggle icon based on state, but on initial render uses useState(getTheme()); if applyTheme is triggered elsewhere the icon can desync. Consider useEffect subscribing to storage events.
test_credentials: admin@teachhub.com/admin12345, teacher@teachhub.com/teacher12345 verified. Throwaway users registered & deleted during test run.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: one folder, one draft task, one throwaway user for hide_follows cross-user check — all cleaned up. Teacher's hide_follows toggled ON then OFF back to original state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 round-4 fixes verified end-to-end: FIX1 folder-delete confirm (ws-folder-delete-confirm/cancel) works with cancel keeping folder; FIX2 assignment delete dialog has solid white bg (rgb(255,255,255)); FIX3 /edit/<id> shows publish-delete → publish-confirm-delete → navigates to /workspace; FIX4 profile-menu-trigger dropdown solid white; FIX5 ws-logo text is 'TeachHub'; FIX6 settings-hide-follows lives inside Settings tab (must click tab first) — when saved, PublicProfile as another user hides stat-followers/stat-following/pp-tab-followers AND API returns hide_follows=true with counts=null; FIX7 draft flow: POST /api/tasks with is_draft=true → ws-draft-<id> and view-draft-badge visible to owner, GET /api/tasks/<id> 404 for guest & other user, excluded from list_tasks/following_feed; FIX8 ws-eye-toggle removed; FIX9 theme-toggle adds/removes 'dark' on documentElement, persists in localStorage th_theme, and survives reload. Regressions: like/favorite toggle, feed pagination (18 total posts, 2 pages @ 10/page), lang-toggle RU↔EN all working.
